text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...! I'm sorry, I'm so sorry! I-I was 
careless, I just, um...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...I-I ended up having a long phone 
call... with my childhood friend...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's wonderful she got to take her time 
chatting with a friend, but... it seems 
she didn't get proper rest, so it might be 
best to keep an eye on her physical 
condition.
